cooldown.binNote: Bin's ZyraP top-level cooldown field is 8, but the by-level formula in ZyraP#SeedCooldown (13.6..9.05) matches the wiki's stated pattern/probability cooldown; the flat 8 appears to be a stale/default placeholder rather than the actual per-level Seed spawn cooldown.

values.binNote: Wiki states Seed duration as 30 seconds, but ZyraP.PlantDuration in the bin is 8; no bin row for 30 is present (this slot's SeedDuration=60 belongs to the W spell, not P).

values.meaning: maximum number of Seeds Zyra can have planted at once
values.quote: '''Zyra''' can only have a total of 8 ''Seeds'' planted at a time
values.binNote: No bin row in this slot corresponds to a Seed cap; it is presumably enforced elsewhere.

mechanics.claim: Seeds can be turned into plants by hitting them with Zyra's basic abilities.
mechanics.quote: {{cis|Zyra}} {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} can be turned into plants by hitting them with her basic abilities.

mechanics.claim: Enemy champions can destroy a Seed by walking over it, but only after it has existed for 1 second.
mechanics.quote: After 1 second, enemy {{tip|champions}} can destroy ''Seeds'' by moving on top of them.

mechanics.claim: When the 8-Seed cap is reached, Seeds spawned by Rampant Growth (W) are kept in preference over Seeds spawned by this passive.
mechanics.quote: preserving {{as|Seeds|buzzword}} spawned by ''{{ai|Rampant Growth|Zyra}}'' over {{as|Seeds|buzzword2}} spawned by ''Garden of Thorns''

mechanics.claim: Newly spawned Seeds grant vision of the surrounding area for 1 second.
mechanics.quote: granting {{tip|sight}} over the surrounding area for 1 second
